verdict.rationale: Letta is a stateful-agent platform built around persistent memory, so temporal validity of facts is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence documents tracking when facts became valid or invalid, or separating current from outdated facts. Dreaming consolidation, /doctor audits of drift and duplication, and Git-backed MemFS are related memory-maintenance features, not temporal fact validity, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can track when facts became valid or invalid (temporal reasoning) so the memory distinguishes current from outdated information
